name: Vril
tagline: Describe a physical product or upload a reference and get an editable 3D model plus print-ready packaging.
problem: People with product ideas lack the 3D-modelling skills, time or budget to design even simple items and their packaging.
solution: Generates editable 3D models from text or reference images, offers a prompt-driven editor for geometry and materials, and generates packaging with textures, dielines and artwork editable panel by panel, ready to export.
demo_moment: Team-described: type a product idea and watch a 3D model and its box appear, then edit them by prompt.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “First Place Overall” and “[MLH] Best Use of Gemini API” among 82 submissions.
Pitched as making product design as accessible as AI app builders made coding.
Covers the product and its packaging, down to printable dielines.
Answers the 'world is your canvas' theme with a tool for making physical things.

lessons: A familiar comparison ("like an AI app builder, for products") explains a new tool in one breath.
